children: Salvatore Ferragamo could report soft revenue figures for the third quarter, mirroring the complex environment in the luxury sector, Equita SIM's Paola Carboni writes in a research note. The analyst expects the Italian luxury-fashion company to report a slowdown in both the direct-to-consumer and the wholesale channels. "We estimate that July was the weakest month," she says. This is due to the company's strategy of reducing discounting during the end-of-season sales period, she adds. Since the company reported second-quarter results on Aug. 3, Salvatore Ferragamo has been the worst-performing stock in the luxury sector. Carboni says. The stock trades 3.6% lower. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
